forced_mode: Near-end PMA LOOPBACK010 before coldstartup; VIO defaults0
criterion: InternalGT RXFSMdone +PCSsync +bytealignment +error-free frozenRX waveform; externalTCP/RBCP intentionally unavailable, not counted as boot failure.
inference: Failure can occur in internalGT loopback without requiring external Ethernet packet stream. Combined with current sharedCPLL mean clock unchanged / recoveredRXclock abnormal, this supports board-local receiveGT initialization sensitivity.
limits: Historical cohorts were re-read and image proofs rechecked; not new trials or a new failure-rate estimate.
Internal loopback still uses shared PLL/local TX clock and internal analog path. Does not uniquely isolate CDR, reference jitter, MGT supply, termination or silicon defect.
Does not prove that connected cable or external electrical coupling has zero analog influence.
